adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `blacklistedGuestEmails` is built as a lowercased list (`.map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`), but the filter compares it against the raw `guest` string: `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`. Since `includes` is case-sensitive and `guest` is not normalized (no `.toLowerCase()`), a blacklisted address entered with different casing can bypass the blacklist and be persisted/emailed, matching the finding.
